voice.name: Open Sector - Sim Unit
voice.description: Quiet, smooth male voice of a stealthy cyborg infiltrator and assassin: low and soft, close to a whisper, cold and precise with a thin synthetic digital shimmer and a faint glitch at the edges of words, calm, patient and predatory, never raises his voice.
voice.sample: Sim Unit online. Blink drive charged. They will not see me until the blades are already inside. Point me at the garrison and I will empty it, quietly, and be gone.

fire.prompt: Two fast energy dagger slashes: sharp humming electric blades swishing through the air with a crackling sizzle on contact, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Sci-fi short-range teleport blink: a quick inward whoosh, a sharp digital glitch zap and an outward pop of displaced air, very short, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Light agile cyborg running: quiet quick footsteps on dirt with soft servo whirs and a faint electronic hum, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Light cyborg destroyed: electric sparks and short circuit crackle, energy blades fizzling out with a dying whine, a light metal body dropping to the ground, close, no music, no voice
